release.content: pubkit 0.16.0 was released on 2026-10-29 from commit 1b72c6df9a5e88df2503b4a1ba05470f5aaf5f8b with these changes.

rows: pubkit sync pins the reusable workflows it writes, pubkit's job-*.yml and pubrel's release.yml, to the full commit of the release's tag with the version in a comment (@<commit> # vX.Y.Z) instead of the tag, so SonarQube Cloud's S7637 needs no exception. The release CI writes the tag's commit into the wheel as release-commit, so sync needs no network for pubkit's; pubrel's is recorded, reused from the workflows, or read once with git ls-remote. pubkit bump and the nightly's pubkit pins move the commit with the version. conform, freshness, the nightly and the board read both forms, so workflows pinned by tag still read and check

The owner of the pubkit and pubrel workflows a repository calls is set in one place, OWNER in src/pubkit/refs.py (schryer for now), and pubkit.json can override it with workflows_owner. pubkit sync, pubkit pins, pubkit bump and the pubrel tag lookup pin to that owner; conform, freshness, the nightly, the board and audit prepare read a pin under any owner, so workflows still pinned to schryer keep working after the transfer
